title: deutzia × elegantissima f. arcuata
intro: Deutzia × elegantissima f. arcuata, commonly known as Deutzia 'Arcata', is a flowering plant belonging to the Hydrangeaceae family. It is known for its fragrant white flowers and attractive foliage. This plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Deutzia 'Arcata' include phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and cardiovascular protective effects.
